title: ✨ Skin & Hair Rejuvenation with Ayurveda in India
h1: Natural Beauty & Holistic Wellness from Within
intro: Ayurveda believes that true beauty comes from inner balance. Skin and hair problems are often linked to toxins, stress, poor digestion, and hormonal imbalance. With authentic Ayurvedic therapies, herbal medicines, and personalized diets, patients can achieve healthy skin and strong, lustrous hair — naturally and without side effects.

sections.heading: Benefits of Ayurvedic Skin & Hair Rejuvenation
points: Clears acne, pigmentation & blemishes
Reduces wrinkles & signs of aging
Treats chronic skin conditions (eczema, psoriasis, vitiligo)
Strengthens hair roots & prevents hair fall
Controls dandruff & premature greying
Improves glow, radiance & confidence

sections.heading: Popular Ayurvedic Therapies for Skin & Hair
points: Mukhalepam (Herbal Face Pack): Improves skin tone & removes blemishes
Abhyanga (Oil Massage): Nourishes skin & improves circulation
Takradhara (Buttermilk Therapy): Soothes skin, reduces stress & inflammation
Herbal Steam Therapy: Opens pores & eliminates toxins
Shirodhara (Oil Drip Therapy): Reduces stress, a key cause of hair loss
Ayurvedic Herbal Oils & Medicines: Tailored to restore balance and rejuvenate

sections.heading: Why Choose Ayurveda in India for Skin & Hair Care?
points: Natural, safe & chemical-free solutions
Personalized therapies based on body type (dosha)
Addresses root cause – not just symptoms
Affordable rejuvenation packages
Treatments in wellness destinations like Kerala, Rishikesh, Goa, and Himalayan retreats

sections.heading: Cost of Skin & Hair Rejuvenation Packages in India
points: 1-Week Rejuvenation Program: $250 – $400
2-Week Intensive Program: $500 – $800
3-Week Complete Rejuvenation: $850 – $1,300
Includes consultation, therapies, herbal medicines, and accommodation.
